columns.name: num_podcasts
columns.description: Number of podcasts in the category, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_reviews
columns.description: The number of reviews of podcasts in the category, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_rating
columns.description: The average of all individual review ratings for podcasts that belong to the category.

columns.name: latest_review_podcast_title
columns.description: The title of the podcast with the latest review in the category, with ties broken by the ascending order of the podcast title.

columns.name: includes_podcast_with_jessica_in_title
columns.description: Set to 1 if the category includes a podcast with 'Jessica' in the title, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: podcast_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the podcast.

columns.name: has_at_least_four_categories
columns.description: Set to 1 if the podcast are categorized in four or more categories, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: avg_rating
columns.description: The average rating of the podcast

columns.name: content_of_earliest_review
columns.description: The content of the earliest review of the podcast, with ties broken by the ascending order of the review content.

columns.name: num_people_rated_5
columns.description: The number of people who rated the podcast 5, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: longest_review
columns.description: The longest review of the podcast, with ties broken by the descending order of the review content.
